# satuRn differential transcript usage

## Takeaway

satuRn fits scalable quasi-binomial models for transcript usage in bulk and single-cell RNA-seq. It complements gene-level differential expression when isoform composition is the scientific question.

## Input and output

- Input: transcript counts, transcript-to-gene mapping, sample metadata and biological replicates.
- Output: transcript-level DTU statistics, adjusted p-values and usage summaries.
- Record: transcript filtering, design matrix, contrasts, package version and transcript annotation.

## Official material

- Paper: https://doi.org/10.12688/f1000research.51749.1
- Code: https://github.com/statOmics/satuRn
- Reproduction: https://github.com/statOmics/satuRnPaper
- Turnkey entry: R/04_satuRn_dtu.R.

## Limitation

DTU needs enough biological replication and informative isoforms. A significant transcript-level result should be checked against gene-level expression and annotation quality.
